_comment: Texts of the Apple apps only: prefix ios_ for what Android says differently or does not have, prefix macos_ for what only the Mac app says. Merged into Localizable.xcstrings by strings-from-android.py; same tone (English, plain "you").
ios_create_camera_unavailable: No camera available here. Paste or enter the installation key.
ios_debug_departure: Demo: simulate the server on departure
ios_debug_enter_demo_hint: Debug build only. Bypasses pairing (no network, demo data) and opens the feed. Otherwise, enter any code (e.g. 7-crayon-lune): the demo verification code is 482913.
ios_debug_simulate_later: Simulate a hidden item in 5 s (notification)
ios_devices_add_reason: Add a device to your space
ios_devices_add_unavailable: Set up a screen lock (passcode or biometrics) to add a device to your space.
ios_devices_revoke_reason: Remove a device from your space
ios_notif_device_added_body: %1$@ is now part of your space. Not you? Remove it from Devices.
ios_notice_files_skipped: Some files were not attached: 25 MB maximum per file, 20 files at most.
ios_onboarding_headline: Add Tomi to your share favorites
ios_onboarding_step_2: 2. Scroll the row of apps to the end, then tap More.
ios_onboarding_step_3: 3. Tap Edit, then add Tomi to the favorites: it then stays at the top, in the same place.
ios_pair_camera_unavailable: No camera available here. Enter the invitation code shown on the other device.
ios_pair_error_unsupported: This version of Tomi cannot join a space yet.
ios_share_inbox_expired: A share that could not be sent for more than 7 days was deleted.
ios_share_inbox_failed: A share could not be sent. Tomi will try again.
ios_capture_cover: Hidden content is shown while the screen of this iPhone is being shared or recorded. Tomi covers it so that it does not appear in the copy.
ios_capture_cover_close: Hide and go back to the feed
ios_capture_share_blocked: The screen is being shared or recorded: hidden content cannot be shared right now.
ios_unreadable_reset_failed: Erasing failed. Try again, or delete the app and reinstall it.
ios_capture_cover_pairing: The screen of this iPhone is being shared or recorded. Tomi covers the pairing code so that it does not appear in the copy: someone who saw it could join your space.
ios_capture_step_island: Tap the sharing icon at the top of the screen, then “Stop”.
ios_capture_step_mac: Or close iPhone Mirroring on your Mac.
ios_capture_step_record: Or stop the screen recording in Control Center.
ios_capture_resume: Tomi resumes by itself as soon as the sharing stops.
ios_file_preview_none: This type of file cannot be shown here. Open it in an app that can read it.
ios_file_hidden: A hidden file is not shown in Tomi: its preview would escape the screen protection. You can share it to another app after Face ID.
ios_file_load_failed: Couldn’t open this file. Try again in a moment.
ios_relay_revoked_admin: %1$@ was removed by the administrator of the relay.
ios_relay_revoked_other: %1$@ was removed from your space by the relay.
ios_relay_revoked_self: %1$@ left your space, according to the relay.
ios_rotation_stalled_body: A removed device may still hold the current key of your space. Tomi retries automatically; open Tomi on your other devices to help.
